# Topic 7: Coastal Landscapes

This topic, we will look at landscapes shaped by rivers.

By the end of this topic you should be able to:
1. Explain the main processes operating in coastal landscape areas
2. Discuss the balance between erosion and deposition in coastal areas
3. Describe the main coastal landforms

## Lecture

Lecture slides: [L7 Coastal Landscapes](./assets/lectures/L7_Coastal_Landscapes.pdf)

## Reading

### Suggested Textbook

I suggest reading Chapter 13 of Huggett, R. (2017) Fundamentals of Geomorphology, 4th Edition. Routledge, London.

This is the chapter on coastal landscapes.

Available [online](https://archive.org/details/routledgefundamentalsofphysical/).

### Academic papers

- Blum, M.D. and Roberts, H.H. 2012. The Mississippi Delta Region: Past, Present, and Future. *Annual Review of Earth and Planetary Sciences* **40**, 655–683p. doi: [10.1146/annurev-earth-042711-105248](https://doi.org/10.1146/annurev-earth-042711-105248K)

This is a nice review paper summarising what is known about the Mississippi Delta.

- Zhao, Z., Mitchell, N.C., Quartau, R., Ramalho, R.S., and Rusu, L. 2020. Coastal erosion rates of lava deltas around oceanic islands. *Geomorphology* **370**, 107410. doi: [10.1016/j.geomorph.2020.107410](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.geomorph.2020.107410)

I like this paper because it showcases some of the methods used in studying coastal geomorphology and erosion, which will be new to you, and also because it's something a bit different (volcanic islands) but the conclusions are more broadly applicable.

### Optional additional reading

In this lecture we looked at the gradual processes of coastal erosion and deposition.

It isn't always gradual.

- Atwater, B.F. 1987 Evidence for Great Holocene Earthquakes along the Outer Coast of Washington State. *Science* **236**, 942-944 [Access via library](https://www-jstor-org.glucksman.idm.oclc.org/stable/1699641)
